from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u051/system/state/workspace/programs/task-9f087961.py')

source='''def transform(grid):
    background = max(set(value for row in grid for value in row), key=lambda value: sum(row.count(value) for row in grid))
    counts = {}
    seen = set()
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            stack = [(r, c)]
            seen.add((r, c))
            while stack:
                y, x = stack.pop()
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < height and 0 <= nx < width and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny,nx))
                        stack.append((ny,nx))
            counts[color] = counts.get(color, 0) + 1
    cells = [color for color in sorted(counts, reverse=True) for _ in range(counts[color])]
    cells = (cells + [0] * 6)[:6]
    return [cells[:3], cells[3:]]
'''
